basic_info.description: Originally built in 1940 and thoughtfully remodeled in 2020, this Noe Valley residence offers the ideal balance of timeless character and modern comfort. The home spans two spacious levels with three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, two living rooms (one on the main floor and one down, and a formal dining room, providing versatility for both daily living and entertaining. Classic details such as inlaid hardwood floors and a built-in gas fireplace are paired with fresh updates, including a remodeled kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a light-filled breakfast room. Multiple gathering spaces ensure flexibility, while serene bedrooms and updated baths add to the sense of ease and comfort. Indoor-outdoor living comes naturally with a walk-out garden terrace, well suited for al fresco dining, relaxation, or gardening. Flooded with natural light and designed for functionality, 1026 Castro Street is a rare find that feels both classic and contemporary.
